import glob, re
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

files = sorted(glob.glob('/app/logs/*.log'))
per_date = {}
for f in files:
    d = datetime.strptime(f.split('/')[-1].split('_')[0], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    per_date.setdefault(d, {'ERROR':0,'WARNING':0,'INFO':0,'DEBUG':0})
    for line in open(f):
        m = re.match(r'^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} \[([^\]]+)\]', line)
        if not m: continue
        s = m.group(2)
        if s in per_date[d]: per_date[d][s] += 1

ref = date(2025,8,12)
def rc(start, end):
    c = {'ERROR':0,'WARNING':0,'INFO':0}
    for d,v in per_date.items():
        if start <= d <= end:
            for k in c: c[k]+=v[k]
    return c
last7 = rc(ref-timedelta(days=6), ref)
last30 = rc(ref-timedelta(days=29), ref)
